name: Top-down action
core_loop: Enter a room and read the enemy mix
Dash out of the first wave's reach
Swing or shoot until the room is clear
Take the drop and open the next door

questions.question: Is combat melee, ranged, or both?
How does the player move through the level?
Should enemies arrive steadily or in swarms?

acceptance.promise: A dash covers more ground than a walk and cannot be spammed.
setup: Load one arena room with the player at its centre
probes: Walk for one second and record the distance
Request a second dash immediately and record whether it fires
evidence: The dash distance exceeds the walked distance
The second dash is refused until dash_cooldown has elapsed
The player collider never leaves the arena bounds

acceptance.promise: The room reports cleared exactly when the last enemy dies, and not before.
setup: Spawn the authored chaser count in one room
probes: Kill every enemy but one and read the room state
Kill the last enemy and read the room state and HUD score
evidence: The room state stays uncleared while one enemy lives
The room reports cleared once, on the final kill
The HUD score rises by the authored amount per kill
